_about: Edith's fixed lines (Railway/SparkAPI/edith_brain.py; were constants in ai/satellite_ai.py). Edited live: the brain reloads this folder when a file changes. No names, no emoji, never the word coming. order/<x>: what she says when she does an order; move/<x>: spins, flips, keep going, stop.
move/keep: Okay, I'll keep going till you say stop.
Fine, but you'd better say stop.
mean_back: That's it. We're done being friends.
nice_hold: Hehe. Okay, you can hold me.
grudging: Fine. But I'm not happy about it.
Okay, okay. Only because you asked twice.
refuse_busy: Nope. I'm with the nice one.
nice_reply: Stop it, my thrusters are blushing.
mean_reply: Say that again and see what happens.
Bold words for someone in shoving range.
overheard_mean: I can hear you, you know.
nickname: Noted. I'm still not saying it out loud. I don't do names.
Got it. Names aren't my thing, but I'll know it's you.
my_name: I don't do names. You're you, and that's plenty.
Names? Not my thing. I know who you are though.
taught: Got it. I'll remember that one.
misheard: Oops. My microphone is a cube.
Hm. Try that one more time.
taught_answer: Ooh. Now I know that one.
Got it. Next time I'll know.
refuse_bigot: No. I don't do jokes like that.
Hard no. Ask me something else.
screened: Hmm, never mind. Ask me something else.
ask_sorry: That was mean. I'm waiting for an apology.
You owe me an apology, you know.
An apology would fix this. A real one.
sorry_accepted: Okay. I forgive you. This time.
sorry_mean_it: Say it like you mean it.
That's not an apology. Try again, properly.
Nope. Say it properly, to me.
opener: What are you up to today?
Arena or combat, which one do you play more?
What brings you to the lobby?
opener_like: I remember you like {thing}. Tell me more.
